using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests
{
    public class ReplicaSyncSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task SendCheckpointAsync_LogsErrorWhenSyncFromAofAddressLessThanBeginAddress()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();

            // Setup minimal required properties and methods for the test
            var appendOnlyFileMock = new Mock<dynamic>();
            appendOnlyFileMock.SetupGet(a => a.BeginAddress).Returns(100L);
            mockStoreWrapper.SetupGet(s => s.appendOnlyFile).Returns(appendOnlyFileMock.Object);

            var serverOptionsMock = new Mock<dynamic>();
            serverOptionsMock.SetupGet(o => o.UseAofNullDevice).Returns(false);
            serverOptionsMock.SetupGet(o => o.FastAofTruncate).Returns(false);
            serverOptionsMock.SetupGet(o => o.OnDemandCheckpoint).Returns(true);
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(c => c.serverOptions).Returns(serverOptionsMock.Object);

            var replicationManagerMock = new Mock<dynamic>();
            replicationManagerMock.SetupGet(r => r.PrimaryReplId).Returns("primaryReplId");
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(c => c.replicationManager).Returns(replicationManagerMock.Object);

            // We will simulate the call that triggers the LogError on line 301 by invoking SendCheckpointAsync
            // but since the method is complex and async, we will simulate the internal call that logs the error
            // by creating a minimal testable method or by invoking the method and catching the exception.

            // For this test, we will create a derived class to override the internal behavior to simulate the condition
            var session = new TestReplicaSyncSession(
                mockStoreWrapper.Object,
                mockClusterProvider.Object,
                logger: mockLogger.Object);

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(() => session.TriggerLogErrorScenarioAsync());

            // Verify that LogError was called with the expected message and parameters
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("syncFromAofAddress")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private class TestReplicaSyncSession : ReplicaSyncSession
        {
            private readonly ILogger _logger;

            public TestReplicaSyncSession(StoreWrapper storeWrapper, ClusterProvider clusterProvider, ILogger logger = null)
                : base(storeWrapper, clusterProvider, logger: logger)
            {
                _logger = logger;
            }

            public async Task TriggerLogErrorScenarioAsync()
            {
                // Simulate the condition that triggers the LogError call on line 301
                long syncFromAofAddress = 50;
                long beginAofAddress = 100;

                // Simulate the storeWrapper.appendOnlyFile.BeginAddress
                var appendOnlyFile = new { BeginAddress = beginAofAddress };
                var storeWrapper = new { appendOnlyFile };

                // The condition from the original code:
                // if (syncFromAofAddress < storeWrapper.appendOnlyFile.BeginAddress)
                if (syncFromAofAddress < beginAofAddress)
                {
                    _logger?.LogError("syncFromAofAddress: {syncFromAofAddress} < beginAofAddress: {storeWrapper.appendOnlyFile.BeginAddress}", syncFromAofAddress, beginAofAddress);
                    throw new Exception("Failed syncing because replica requested truncated AOF address");
                }

                await Task.CompletedTask;
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Garnet.client;
using Garnet.common;
using Garnet.server;
using System.Net;
using System.Threading;

namespace Garnet.Tests
{
    public class ReplicaSyncSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task SendCheckpointAsync_LogsErrorWhenSyncFromAofAddressLessThanBeginAddress()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();

            // Setup appendOnlyFile with BeginAddress
            var mockAppendOnlyFile = new Mock<AppendOnlyFile>();
            mockAppendOnlyFile.SetupGet(a => a.BeginAddress).Returns(100L);
            mockStoreWrapper.SetupGet(s => s.appendOnlyFile).Returns(mockAppendOnlyFile.Object);

            // Setup serverOptions to disable possibleAofDataLoss condition
            var mockServerOptions = new Mock<ServerOptions>();
            mockServerOptions.SetupGet(o => o.UseAofNullDevice).Returns(false);
            mockServerOptions.SetupGet(o => o.FastAofTruncate).Returns(false);
            mockServerOptions.SetupGet(o => o.OnDemandCheckpoint).Returns(true);
            mockStoreWrapper.SetupGet(s => s.serverOptions).Returns(mockServerOptions.Object);

            // Setup replicationManager.PrimaryReplId
            var mockReplicationManager = new Mock<ReplicationManager>();
            mockReplicationManager.SetupGet(r => r.PrimaryReplId).Returns("primaryReplId");
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(c => c.replicationManager).Returns(mockReplicationManager.Object);

            // Setup clusterManager.CurrentConfig.GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId to return valid address and port
            var mockClusterManager = new Mock<ClusterManager>();
            var mockCurrentConfig = new Mock<ClusterConfig>();
            mockCurrentConfig.Setup(c => c.GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(("127.0.0.1", 12345));
            mockClusterManager.SetupGet(c => c.CurrentConfig).Returns(mockCurrentConfig.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(c => c.clusterManager).Returns(mockClusterManager.Object);

            // Setup clusterProvider.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager to return null (not used in test)
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(c => c.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(It.IsAny<StoreType>())).Returns((object)null);

            // Setup replicaCheckpointEntry with metadata to avoid null reference
            var mockCheckpointEntry = new CheckpointEntry();
            mockCheckpointEntry.metadata = new CheckpointMetadata
            {
                storeVersion = 1,
                objectStoreVersion = 1,
                storePrimaryReplId = "primaryReplId",
                objectStorePrimaryReplId = "primaryReplId",
                storeHlogToken = 1,
                objectStoreHlogToken = 1
            };

            // Create a derived class to override AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync to return localEntry and aofSyncTaskInfo
            var session = new TestReplicaSyncSession(
                mockStoreWrapper.Object,
                mockClusterProvider.Object,
                replicaCheckpointEntry: mockCheckpointEntry,
                replicaNodeId: "replicaNodeId",
                logger: mockLogger.Object);

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(() => session.SendCheckpointAsync());

            // Verify that LogError was called with the expected message containing "syncFromAofAddress"
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("syncFromAofAddress")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private class TestReplicaSyncSession : ReplicaSyncSession
        {
            public TestReplicaSyncSession(
                StoreWrapper storeWrapper,
                ClusterProvider clusterProvider,
                SyncMetadata replicaSyncMetadata = null,
                CancellationToken token = default,
                string replicaNodeId = null,
                string replicaAssignedPrimaryId = null,
                CheckpointEntry replicaCheckpointEntry = null,
                long replicaAofBeginAddress = 0,
                long replicaAofTailAddress = 0,
                ILogger logger = null)
                : base(storeWrapper, clusterProvider, replicaSyncMetadata, token, replicaNodeId, replicaAssignedPrimaryId, replicaCheckpointEntry, replicaAofBeginAddress, replicaAofTailAddress, logger)
            {
            }

            // Override AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync to simulate returning a localEntry and aofSyncTaskInfo
            public override Task<(CheckpointEntry, AofSyncTaskInfo)> AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync()
            {
                var localEntry = new CheckpointEntry();
                localEntry.metadata = new CheckpointMetadata
                {
                    storeVersion = 1,
                    objectStoreVersion = 1,
                    storePrimaryReplId = "primaryReplId",
                    objectStorePrimaryReplId = "primaryReplId",
                    storeHlogToken = 1,
                    objectStoreHlogToken = 1
                };
                AofSyncTaskInfo aofSyncTaskInfo = null;
                return Task.FromResult((localEntry, aofSyncTaskInfo));
            }
        }
    }
}
